[[EuroLeague]] | position = [[Small forward]] | height_ft = 6 | height_in = 9 | weight_lbs = 220 | team = FC Barcelona Lassa | number = 17 | nationality = Latvian | birth_date = {{birth date and age|1998|2|5}} | birth_place = [[Cēsis]], Latvia | high_school = | college = | career_start = 2012 | career_end = | years1 = 2012–2015 | team1 = [[BK VEF Rīga|VEF Rīga]] | years2 = 2012–2014 | team2 = →VEF Rīga Skola | years3 = 2015–present | team3 = [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]] | years4 = 2015–2016 | team4 = →FC Barcelona Junior | years5 = 2016–2017 | team5 = →[[FC Barcelona Bàsquet B|FC Barcelona B]] | highlights = * [[Copa del Rey de Baloncesto|Spanish Cup]] winner ([[2018 Copa del Rey de Baloncesto|2018]]) | medaltemplates = {{MedalSport|Men's basketball}} {{MedalCountry|{{flagicon|LAT}} [[Latvia national basketball team|Latvia]]}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]]}} {{MedalSilver|[[2014 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship|2014 Latvia]]|}} }} '''Rodions Kurucs''' (born February 5, 1998 in [[Cēsis]]) is a Latvian professional [[basketball]] player who plays as a [[small forward]] for [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona Lassa]] of the [[Liga ACB]]. At a height of 2.06 m (6'9") tall,[http://www.euroleague.net/competition/players/showplayer?pcode=005713#!careerstats KURUCS, RODIONS HEIGHT: 2.06.] he plays at the [[small forward]] position. == Professional career == === Early career=== In March 2014, Kurucs signed a multi-year contract with the Latvian club [[BK VEF Rīga|VEF Rīga]],{{Cite web|url=https://www.vefriga.com/en/news/news/vef-riga-sign-rodions-kurucs-1566|title=VEF Rīga sign Rodions Kurucs|website=www.vefriga.com|accessdate=2016-04-16}} after having played for the club's youth academy, VEF Rīga Skola, in Latvia's second men's division (LBL2). He made his debut on VEF's first team, during the 2014–15 campaign, logging his first minutes in Latvia's top-tier level league, the [[Latvian Basketball League|LBL]],{{Cite web|url=http://www.fiba.com/pages/eng/fc/gamecent/p/pid/6064539/playerview.html|title=Rodions Kurucs profile {{!}} Game center {{!}} FIBA.com|website=www.fiba.com|accessdate=2016-04-16}} in the Eastern European regional [[VTB United League]],{{Cite web|url=http://www.vtb-league.com/en/player/1825491/?seasonId=89632|title=Rodions Kurucs - game statistics, games, data, player photo Rodions Kurucs, VEF {{!}} VTB United League|website=www.vtb-league.com|accessdate=2016-04-16}} and in [[European professional club basketball system|Europe's 2nd-tier level league]], the [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]].{{Cite web|url=http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/competition/players/showplayer?pcode=005713&seasoncode=U2014|title=KURUCS, RODIONS - Welcome to Eurocup|website=www.eurocupbasketball.com|accessdate=2016-04-16}} He played at the [[Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament|Adidas Next Generation Tournament]] in 2015.{{Cite web|url=http://www.adidasngt.com/u18/news/latest/i/5yiudajyheqei8c5/vef-riga-star-kurucs-looks-to-stands-for-guidance|title=VEF Riga star Kurucs looks to stands for guidance|website=ADIDAS Next Generation Tournament|accessdate=2016-04-16}} ===FC Barcelona=== In July 2015, Kurucs agreed to a four-year deal with the [[Liga ACB|Spanish]] powerhouse [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]].{{cite news|title=FCB Lassa inks teenage star Kurucs for four years|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/67sovyyxrrrgnby6|accessdate=16 April 2016|work=EuroLeague.net|date=21 July 2015|language=en}} He then spent the 2015–16 season playing in the junior club of FC Barcelona. In 2016, after turning 18 years of age, Kurucs joined the [[farm team|reserve team]] of [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]], [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet B|FC Barcelona B]], of the [[LEB Oro]], which is [[Spanish basketball league system|the second-tier level in the Spanish league system]].[http://competiciones.feb.es/estadisticas/Jugador.aspx?i=733212&c=2159647&med=0 Federación Española de Baloncesto KURUCS, RODIONS {{es icon}}.] Kurucs made his debut in the [[European professional club basketball system|European-wide top-tier level]] [[EuroLeague]], on 24 March, 2017, in a 67–54 home win against [[KK Crvena zvezda|Red Star Belgrade]]. In his first EuroLeague game, he logged 3 minutes of playing time, and scored 2 points.[http://www.euroleague.net/main/results/showgame?gamecode=222&seasoncode=E2016 FC BARCELONA LASSA 67 CRVENA ZVEZDA MTS BELGRADE 54 MARCH 24, 2017.] ===NBA draft rights=== Kurucs entered his name into the [[2017 NBA draft]],{{Cite web|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2017/04/rodions-kurucs-enters-2017-nba-draft.html|title=Rodions Kurucs Enters 2017 NBA Draft|website=Hoops Rumors|language=en-US|access-date=2017-05-01}} being one of a record-high 182 underclassmen to do so that year. However, despite being consistently considered a first round draft pick throughout most mock drafts, Kurucs ultimately withdrew his name from the draft, on June 12; the deadline date that international players had decide to whether or not to withdraw their names from the [[NBA Draft]]. Kurucs would later enter his name for the [[2018 NBA Draft]] as one of 236 underclassed prospects willing to enter the draft. This time, however, he would stay in the draft, being one of only 11 truly international underclassmen to stay in the 2018 NBA Draft. == International career == Kurucs played for the Latvian Under-16 national team at the 2014 Baltic Sea Cup, and at the [[2014 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]]. He played a crucial role in helping Latvia win the silver medal at the tournament, as he averaged 13.4 points, 5.9 rebounds, 1.9 assists, 1.4 steals, and 1.1 blocked shots per contest,{{Cite web|url=http://www.fibaeurope.com/compID_YUjW-7-FJ,kK9s431Lyr41.season_2014.roundID_9771.teamID_2134.playerID_116175.html|title=Rodions Kurucs {{!}} U16 European Championship Men (2014) {{!}} FIBA Europe|website=www.fibaeurope.com|accessdate=2016-04-16}} en route to earning a spot on the All-Tournament Team,{{Cite web|url=http://www.fibaeurope.com/compID_YUjW-7-FJ,kK9s431Lyr41.season_2014.roundID_9771.coid_RZGz4WBjI0EEwGX6OT5LZ1.articleMode_on.html|title=Tillie Towers Above The Competition {{!}} U16 European Championship Men (2014) {{!}} FIBA Europe|website=www.fibaeurope.com|accessdate=2016-04-16}} and being selected to the [[Eurobasket.com]]'s website All-European Championship Under-16 First Team.{{Cite web|url=http://www.eurobasket.com/European-Championships-U16/basketball_2014.asp|title=European Championships U16 Basketball, Teams, Scores, Stats, News, Standings -
